title: Make Q&A an expandable foldable item
goal: uses details and summary to implement question and answer that can be clicked to expand and clicked again to collapse.
summary: Readers can first browse the question list in the reading room and then open the answers they need.
tasks: Change the Q&A container to details and keep id="renew".
Change "How to extend the loan?" to summary, the first element of the container, and retain the answer in the container.
makes the Q&A in the collapsed state when the page is opened. Click on the question to expand the answer, and click again to close it.

example.code:
cartons?

Flatten the carton first and then put it into the paper recycling box.
example.note: summary is always visible, clicking it will switch the expanded state of details. The answer is shown or hidden.

hint: To collapse by default, delete the open attribute. When written as open="false", the attribute still exists and the page will still expand when it is opened.
